about.text: light-coloured (almost white), crumbly cheese made from cow's milk, with a fat content around 48%. It has a mild taste, accented with slightly sour tang.

sources.text: lightly pressed, 24 h brine bath, crumbly; ripens in as little as two weeks, up to ten weeks

facts.v: Traditional Welsh Caerphilly holds EU PGI status
